title: Knowledge of public patient involvement among health economists in Ireland: a baseline audit
descriptions: While there is growing public and patient involvement (PPI) in health research in Ireland, there is little information on the extent to which PPI has permeated the field of health economics research. The aim of this scoping study is to explore the knowledge and use of PPI among health economists in Ireland.
